div.head: Ine 43.1
div.ab: Gif mon afylle on wuda wel monige treowa, ⁊ wyrð eft undyrne, forgilde ðreo treowa ælc mid XXX scll'; ne þearf he nan má gildon, wære heora swa fela swa heora wære: forðon seo æx bið melda, nalæs ðeof.

Gif mon afelle on wuda wel monega treowa, ⁊ wyrð eft undierne, forgielde III treowu ælc mid XXX scill.; ne ðearf he hiora má geldan, wære hiora swa fela swa hiora wære: forþon sio ǽsc bið melda, nalles ðeof.

Si quis in nemore multa ligna ceciderit, et postea compareat, soluat tria ligna unumquodque triginta sol.; nec amplius cogitur per legem soluere, quotquot fuerint, quia securis acclamatrix potius est, non fur.

Gif mon afelle on wuda wel monega treowa ⁊ wyrð eft undierne, forgielde III treowu ælc mid XXX sciƚƚ. Ne ðearf he hiora má geldan, wære hiora swa fela swa hiora wære, forþon sio ǽsc bið melda, nalles ðeof.

If a man fells many trees in the forest, and it afterwards is revealed, let him make restitution for three trees each with 30 shillings. He need not make restitution for more no matter how many there were, because the axe is an informant but not a thief.

If anyone fells a large number of trees in a wood, and it afterwards becomes known, he shall pay 30 shillings for each of three trees. He need not pay for more, however many there may be, because the axe is an informer and not a thief.

If anyone fells in the wood quite a number of trees, and it afterwards becomes known, he is to pay for three trees at 30 shillings each; he need not pay for more of them however many they were, for the axe is an informer, not a thief.

Wenn jemand im Walde gar viele Bäume fällt, und es wird späterhin bekannt, entgelte er [nur] 3 Bäume jeden mit 30 Schill.; ihrer mehr braucht er nicht zu zahlen, wären ihrer [auch] so viele wie ihrer wären: denn die Axt ist ein Anzeiger, nicht ein Dieb.

If someone fells a great many trees in the wood, and it becomes known later, let him pay for [only] 3 trees, each with 30 shillings; he need not pay for more of them, however many of them there might be: for the axe is an informer, not a thief.

note.label: contrast
note.quote: Contrast with Alfred §14, which sets an equal fine for felling or burning another's wood.
